purpose: Teach: 名付け/生体/養護/反乱/母国/生き残っ/操縦/発酵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、新種の生物に、名付けられた経緯、興味深いですね。
lines.en: Ren, the background to how you named the new species in your paper — it's really fascinating.
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Leaning in slightly. Genuine curiosity, not performance. A teacher who sees the student, not just the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。生体内のメカニズム、最新の技術で、解明しました。
lines.en: Yes. We clarified the in-body mechanisms using the latest technology.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Slight pause before each clause — he's choosing his words. Quiet pride underneath, but mostly focused on accuracy. Speaking to be understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 養護施設での生物実習、社会的意義、論じていますね。
lines.en: And you've really thought through the social significance of running bio practicals at a care facility.
lines.style: Thoughtful, affirming nod in the voice. Slightly slower pace. She's seeing something most people would miss — and making sure he knows she sees it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者間の反乱、学界の歴史でも、いくつかありました。
lines.en: Yes. There have been several instances of researcher dissent in the history of the field itself.
lines.style: Measured, almost scholarly. A slight deepening of tone — he's moved into territory he's thought about carefully. Not defensive, but grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 母国での研究と、海外の研究、比較されていますね。
lines.en: You've brought together your research back home and work overseas — there's a real comparison there.
lines.style: Nodding approval in the delivery. Steady, encouraging. She's drawing out what she already suspects he's done well. Light, not heavy-handed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。絶滅危機の中で、生き残ってきた種、論文の中心です。
lines.en: Yes. The species that have survived the extinction crisis — that's really the center of the paper.
lines.style: Slight quickening of pace, genuine interest emerging. Less guarded now. The weight of the topic comes through, but so does his care for it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 実験装置の操縦、慎重に、扱われていますね、研究室で。
lines.en: The way you've handled the lab equipment — with real care and precision.
lines.style: Approving, but genuinely observant. She's noticing the discipline underneath. Warm but not soft. The respect of one careful person for another.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。微生物の発酵プロセス、新発見、報告いたしました。
lines.en: Yes. The new findings on the microbe fermentation process — we've reported them now.
lines.style: Slight lift at the end. A quiet sense of completion. Pride held lightly. The smallest exhale of relief mixed with anticipation.
